description: This file defines data structures using TypedDict for configurations and usage details related to Langfuse integration, including optional fields for secret keys, host information, and token usage metrics.

classes.name: LangfuseLoggingConfig
classes.description: TypedDict for Langfuse logging configuration, containing optional secret key, public key, and host URL.

classes.name: LangfuseUsageDetails
classes.description: TypedDict for detailed metrics related to usage, such as input/output tokens and cache creation/read tokens.
